name: Pure Lens - Website Blocker & Focus Timer
description: An all-in-one productivity extension that blocks websites and creates a locked browser so that you can stay focused!

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com https://www.google.com https://www.gstatic.com;
